fingerprint_policy: Fingerprints in this pack are portable and are pinned raw. That holds only under the pack's canonical staging (see fixture-manifest.json -> staging): the graph must be published through the project-owned finalizer with the pinned generated_at '2026-08-17T00:00:00+00:00'. A raw akms.graph.build_graph output published as-is embeds the machine-specific vault mount path and a wall-clock generated_at and will NOT reproduce these digests -- see expected/staleness.json.
reduced_fields_note: These two are the ONLY fields still reduced out, and only when the invocation was run with write_artifacts=True (with write_artifacts=False they are absent from resolution entirely). They are absolute filesystem paths of the scratch root the pack was staged into, so they cannot be pinned. They are NOT inputs to any digest: result.fingerprint, result.resolution_fingerprint, resolution.graph_version and every input_fingerprints entry below are pinned as RAW values and were reproduced byte-identically from two different scratch roots with the global vault mounted at two different absolute paths. The relative result.artifacts paths ARE pinned; use those.
summary: AKMS drops EVERY exact path spec when all of a task's path inputs are documentation (akms.task_context.resolve._is_documentation_only: any path under doc/, docs/ or documentation/, any basename starting with 'readme', and any .md/.mdx/.rst/.adoc/.asciidoc file anywhere). A lesson recorded against a documentation path therefore NEVER reaches the required lane from a documentation-only task, even though the compiler DID emit an exact route for it. This is accepted policy, frozen here so that no consumer can build a fail-closed required-lesson gate on the false premise that 'recorded as required' implies 'delivered as required'.
